platform.name: iOS / iPadOS SwiftUI
platform.nativeUnits: All geometry in DESIGN.md is native logical points; component HTML/CSS previews use the same numeric CSS px values as an illustrative translation, not physical CSS pt.
platform.previewBoundary: Static component previews preserve extracted color and geometry. They do not reproduce Dynamic Type, SF Symbols, Apple semantic colors, native navigation, hit testing or SwiftUI lifecycle behavior. No web hover/focus states are invented.
platform.colorBoundary: Frontmatter percentage rgb values retain source SwiftUI channel precision. System semantic colors remain platform-owned. No synthetic tonal ramp or unimplemented breakpoint was generated.
platform.runtimeBoundary: Current validation uses iOS 27 / iPadOS 27; App and recorder explicitly prefer light. Deployment settings remain separate from validation coverage.

motion.name: voice-level-pulse
motion.purpose: VoiceConversationView 的 152pt 圆背景随音量变化；accessibilityReduceMotion 时显式 animation 为 nil。

motion.name: chat-expand
motion.value: withAnimation(reduceMotion ? nil : .easeOut(duration:0.3)); offset(y: open || reduceMotion ? 0 : geometry.size.height)
motion.purpose: 同一驻留 Chat 从内容区底部上推；Reduce Motion 取消显式动画和大幅位移。

recording-primary.stateComposition: Two source opacity modifiers are applied sequentially.

gestureBoundary.inputArea: When not focused, transparent overlay handles tap to focus and VoiceHoldGesture. When focused, native text selection remains available.
gestureBoundary.holdRecognition: LongPressGesture(minimumDuration:0.35, maximumDistance:45).sequenced(before:DragGesture(minimumDistance:0)); starts capture only in .second(true, drag).
gestureBoundary.sendButton: Outside the input hold overlay; no VoiceHoldGesture on the entire HStack.
gestureBoundary.microphoneButton: Separate tap to begin / tap again to send, with its own hold gesture.

navigation.nativeTypes: TabView, NavigationStack, native segmented Picker, fullScreenCover
navigation.nativeTabPlacement: iPhone bottom / iPad top in reviewed simulator captures; platform-owned
navigation.chatPresentation: One resident Chat layer within Candid; no exposed project or thread selector

narrative.overview:
本文件提取已批准 V2 的原生实现，沿用已有 Warm 配色、系统圆角字体和紫色双气泡 Mascot。少量信息、清楚的正文层级、浅色圆角容器与原生控件构成持续的沟通界面；页面策略以 `PRODUCT.md` 与 `docs/v2-validation/SURFACE.md` 为准。

应用主体、会议录音全屏页与连续语音页均使用 Warm 浅色世界。深度主要通过色面、留白与轻描边表达，导航、安全区、sheet、系统材料和 SF Symbols 由平台提供。动效解释同一内容层的展开与状态变化，并尊重 Reduce Motion。
keyCharacteristics: 米白页面、近白内容、淡紫准备色面、紫色交互与暖橙主要动作。
系统圆角语义文字、原生三目的地和可访问的安全区布局。
同一对话层、清晰的原文时间戳与可追溯依据。

rules.name: The Light Surface Rule
rules.body: 主体、录音全屏与连续语音共享浅色 Warm 世界；系统深色设置不切换当前 App 的色彩方案。

dos: Do 沿用 Warm 源码配色、系统圆角文字和 SF Symbols。
Do 为主体、全屏录音与连续语音保留浅色 scheme。
Do 保留原生导航、安全区、Dynamic Type 与 Reduce Motion 降级。
Do 用文字与图标共同表达状态，保留原文、待确认、依据已更新与示例标记。
donts: Don't 新增字体或替换现有 Mascot 来改变已固定的视觉体系。
Don't 把旧项目页面、四 tab 或深色录音记录作为新表面的依据。
Don't 把系统动态字体、语义颜色或原生导航伪装成固定网页 token。
Don't 用示例截图推断真实数据、外部发送、ASR 或硬件已经通过验收。
